title: CaptureViewport Command
description: Capture a viewport screenshot for visual analysis, with metadata. Any temporary display mode, camera or framing is restored after capture.

viewport.description: Target viewport identifier: active, perspective, top, front, right, back, left, bottom, or custom name

show_grid.description: Whether to show the viewport grid

show_axes.description: Whether to show world axes indicator

show_cplane_axes.description: Whether to show construction plane axes

zoom_to_fit.description: Fit visible objects to the requested image dimensions; restore the original viewport camera and projection after capture

display_mode.description: Display mode name for this capture only, for example Shaded, Wireframe, Rendered, Ghosted, Technical, Arctic. Default: the viewport's current mode

camera_location.description: Temporary camera location [x, y, z]. Cannot be combined with frame_object_ids or frame_bbox

camera_target.description: Temporary camera target [x, y, z]. Cannot be combined with frame_object_ids or frame_bbox

lens_length.description: Temporary 35mm-equivalent lens length in millimetres (perspective views)

frame_object_ids.description: Temporarily frame the capture on these objects. Cannot be combined with camera_location or camera_target

frame_bbox.description: Temporarily frame the capture on this world-space box. Cannot be combined with camera_location or camera_target
